title: Green synthesis of EuCN S-scheme photocatalysts via Centella asiatica extract for enhanced MB photodegradation and H2O2 photoproduction: DFT investigation and mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00035E, Paper

Tran Dang Khoa, Nguyen Phi Hao, Le Thanh Hoang Duc, Pham Duc Nghi, Nguyen Hung Vu, Dang Thanh Cong Minh, Tran Nguyen Cam Nhung, Nguyen Minh Phi, Tran Thi Thu Hanh, Nguyen Minh Hung, Nguyen Huu Hieu
Driven by the growing demand for sustainable environmental remediation and solar energy conversion, europium oxide (Eu2O3) was green synthesized using Centella asiatica extract and integrated with CN to construct EuCN composite photocatalysts.
